title: 第一卷 第91章 目标 诸天美妇第一卷 第90章 转变思路格局打开
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
lines: 一位智者曾经说过，买菜的时候，如果你不知道该怎么挑，那最好的方式……就是从别人的袋子里拿！
相较于故事的序章，更精彩的……是书中的内容！
“老祖，我们以前所关注的各方天之骄女，她们的天赋或许不错，但终究还是太嫩了！”
“就像是温室里的花朵，没有经历过风浪的摧残，论心性、论气运，怎么比得过那些成熟的、知性的、久经磨砺的美妇强者？”
姜无痕望着众人，嘴角勾起一抹坏笑。
“不妨将格局打开，将目标放在那些成名已久的女圣主、女皇，以及那些风韵犹存的女帝身上……”
“但凡能在同代厮杀中，成为强者的存在，年轻时候又有哪个是泛泛之辈？”
“她们久经世事，更懂得如何心疼人，也更清楚自己想要什么……”
姜无痕的话，如同一声惊雷，在几位老祖的耳边炸响。
就连姜临天和姜临渊二人，都忍不住瞪大了眼睛，怔怔的望着姜无痕。
这小子，是真敢想啊！
可不得不说，这的确是一条崭新的思路！
他们扪心自问，自己以前的格局和眼界，确实太窄了。
只想着娶个年轻天骄回来，慢慢养成……
通过联姻，连同她们身后的势力，绑在姜家的战船上。
可姜无痕的话，让他们如拨云见日，茅塞顿开！
直接跟各方势力的女强者联姻……
这不比慢慢养成，简单粗暴的多？
五祖当即一拍大腿，满心激动道：“哈哈哈，小无痕，你小子……真他娘的是个天才！”
“我们这些老家伙……怎么就没想到呢？”
一旁，二祖满意的点点头：“那些成名已久的女圣主，曾经也是她们势力中的圣女。优秀的女人就像是美酒，经历了岁月的沉淀，将变得更加醇香。”
“这些人本身就拥有庞大的势力和能量，若是成为我姜家的帝子妃，简直就是一步到位！”
“妙，妙，妙极！”
他显然对姜无痕的想法，极为满意。
姜玄机摩挲着下巴，饶有兴致的道：“更重要的是，以这些女人的心性、阅历，以及手段，对小无痕道的磨合，可不是那些乳臭未干的小丫头能比的！”
他忽然想到了什么，话锋一转：“小无痕终究年纪尚轻，如今刚纳娶了多位天之骄女，再扬言要对女强者出手。”
“如此荤素不忌，怕是要被世人唾弃，背上淫贼的骂名……”
姜玄机看着一心为家族勤奋耕耘的姜无痕，不禁有些心疼。
姜无痕拱手，义正言辞道：“为了家族，我个人的得失荣辱……又算得了什么？”
“好孩子，真是苦了你了！”
姜齐天轻叹，随即目光一凝：“既然主意已定，那就按小无痕说的做吧！”
content_en:
A wise man once said that when shopping for groceries, if you don’t know what to choose, the best way… is to take it from other people’s bags!
Compared to the prologue of the story, what’s even more exciting…is the content in the book!
"Ancestor, the proud girls from all over the world that we have paid attention to before may have good talents, but they are still too young after all!"
"Like flowers in a greenhouse, they have not experienced the ravages of wind and waves. In terms of character and luck, how can they compare with those mature, intellectual, and tempered beautiful women and strong men?"
Jiang Wuhen looked at everyone, with a smirk on his lips.
"We might as well open up the situation and target those long-famous female saints, queens, and those empresses who still have their charm..."
"As long as there are those who can become strong in the fight of the same generation, who was an ordinary person when they were young?"
"They have experienced the world for a long time, know how to care for others, and know better what they want..."
Jiang Wuhen's words were like thunder, exploding in the ears of several ancestors.
Even Jiang Lintian and Jiang Linyuan couldn't help but stare at Jiang Wuhen with their eyes wide open.
This kid really dares to think!
But I have to say that this is indeed a brand new idea!
They asked themselves that their previous structure and vision were indeed too narrow.
I just want to marry a young prodigy and slowly develop...
Through marriage, together with the forces behind them, they were tied to the Jiang family's warship.
But Jiang Wuhen's words made them suddenly enlightened!
Directly marrying strong women from all forces...
Isn't this simpler and more crude than developing it slowly?
The Fifth Patriarch immediately slapped his thigh and said excitedly: "Hahaha, Xiao Wuhen, you kid... you are such a fucking genius!"
"We old guys...why didn't we think of this?"
On the side, the Second Ancestor nodded with satisfaction: "Those female saints who have been famous for a long time were once saints in their power. Excellent women are like fine wine. After years of precipitation, they will become more mellow."
"These people possess huge power and energy. If they become the emperor's concubine of my Jiang family, it will be a matter of one step!"
"Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful!"
He was obviously extremely satisfied with Jiang Wuhen's idea.
Jiang Xuanji rubbed his chin and said with great interest: "What's more important is that with the temperament, experience, and methods of these women, their ability to adapt to Xiao Wuhen Dao is not comparable to that of those fresh little girls!"
"It's just..."
He suddenly thought of something and changed the topic: "Xiao Wuhen is still young after all. Now Gangna has married many proud daughters of heaven, and he threatens to attack strong women."
"If I don't scrupulously eat meat and vegetables, I'm afraid I will be cast aside by the world and be called a lecher..."
Jiang Xuanji couldn't help but feel a little distressed when he looked at Jiang Wuhen, who was working hard for his family.
Jiang Wuhen handed over his hand and said righteously: "For the sake of the family, my personal gain and loss, honor and disgrace...what does it matter?"
"Good boy, I'm really sorry for you!"
Jiang Qitian sighed, and then his eyes narrowed: "Now that the decision has been made, let's do what Xiao Wuhen said!"
